mapper.select: SELECT REGION_ID AS regionId , ROUTE_NO AS routeNo , LOW_CNT AS lowCnt , TOTAL_CNT AS totalCnt FROM BUS_LOW_FLOOR_SEEN WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO BUS_LOW_FLOOR_SEEN (REGION_ID, ROUTE_NO, LOW_CNT, TOTAL_CNT, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN) VALUES (#{seen.regionId}, #{seen.routeNo}, #{seen.lowCnt}, #{seen.totalCnt},
CASE WHEN #{seen.lowCnt} > 0 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LOW_CNT = VALUES(LOW_CNT) , TOTAL_CNT = VALUES(TOTAL_CNT) , FIRST_SEEN = COALESCE(FIRST_SEEN, VALUES(FIRST_SEEN)) , LAST_SEEN = NOW()
